observations: eBible explicitly supplies standardized 1769 KJV, not an original-spelling 1611 transcription.

Wikisource 1611 Tobit returned HTTP 404. King James Bible Online has an original-spelling Tobit chapter 1 and a linked scan; its FAQ permits scripture text use, but the full corpus has not been cross-checked.
CCEL older 1913 contents has seven text links, not text links for every listed work.

Archive apocryphapseudep02char OCR has no Latin ASCII letters and is unsuitable for an English import. A separate Toronto OCR was found and fetched; it still needs isolation of translation text from commentary and source-image validation.
Public-domain eligibility and faithful complete-text verification are separate gates. No candidate is asserted to pass both.
Live web release is 280; existing www is 279. No publication, installation, source sync or local build was performed.

Direct follow-up retrievals of 1611 Tobit chapter 2 and 1 Esdras chapter 1 returned HTTP 403, as did the book index and FAQ. The earlier Tobit chapter 1 success does not establish corpus availability.
blockingCondition: Cannot obtain and independently verify the complete requested 1611 Apocrypha corpus: subsequent chapter fetches return HTTP 403; checked alternatives are incomplete or explicitly 1769. No edition substitution is authorized.
